description: This file 'chainlint.pl' is a Perl script that analyzes shell scripts for common problems in test definitions, such as broken command chains and unclosed heredocs. It contains modules for lexing, parsing shell scripts, and specialized functions for analyzing test constructs and their correctness.

classes.name: Lexer
classes.description: A lexical analyzer for POSIX shell scripts, tokenizing commands, strings, operators, and heredocs.

classes.name: ShellParser
classes.description: A recursive descent parser for shell scripts that creates command and control structures.

classes.name: TestParser
classes.description: A subclass of ShellParser, enhanced with semantic analysis for test definitions and detecting problematic test constructs.

classes.name: ScriptParser
classes.description: A subclass of ShellParser that identifies individual test definitions within scripts and passes their bodies to TestParser for analysis.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: High-level method in ShellParser to parse tokens until a stopping condition.

methods.name: check_test
methods.description: In ScriptParser, analyzes a test's body for problems such as missing '&&' or '|| exit/return'.

methods.name: format_problem
methods.description: Maps problem codes to human-readable descriptions.
